title: Registration flow never calls the server; price, promo and Lelek maths are client-side
impact: src/pages/student/RegistrationFlow.tsx:32,55 calls the Zustand store's local createRegistration, which computes base price, promo discount and final price in the browser from store/mock data and persists the result to localStorage. The real, idempotent, server-authoritative api.createRegistration exists at src/lib/api.ts:289 but is never called from any component. Consequences: (1) the server is not the source of truth for price, capacity or registration status on the primary conversion screen, directly violating the server-authority rule in CLAUDE.md; (2) the approved DEC-0001 registration-fee arithmetic and DEC-0002 QARGA10 suspension are now correct on the server but have no live UI consumer, so a user can still be shown the old client-side numbers including a 10 percent QARGA10 discount; (3) registrations created in the browser never reach the database, so capacity, seat release and audit history are not enforced.
evidence: grep of src/**: createRegistration is referenced only in src/lib/api.ts:289 (definition), src/pages/student/RegistrationFlow.tsx:32,55 (store hook) and src/store/useAppStore.ts:76,228 (local implementation) - no component calls the api client
src/store/useAppStore.ts:228 - local createRegistration performs its own price, promo and Lelek arithmetic
Independently reported by qarga-qa-auditor during QW-0004-S03 review and by qarga-backend-engineer during QW-0004-S02 implementation, from separate investigations
server/booking.mjs createRegistration is the authoritative implementation and is covered by 18 passing tests
affectedAreas: strategic priority: finish server-authoritative frontend integration
remediation: Create a dedicated Work OS subtask to wire RegistrationFlow.tsx to api.createRegistration with a generated idempotency key, render the server-returned price breakdown (base, registration fee, total) and the promo_applied/promo_message fields instead of client-computed values, remove the local price and promo arithmetic from useAppStore, and add regression coverage. Assign qarga-integration-engineer with qarga-qa-auditor as independent reviewer.

reviewTrigger.value: Must be resolved or explicitly accepted by the project owner before any release-readiness READY status, and before DEC-0001 can be considered delivered to users

title: Unreviewed permission expansion in settings.local.json is invisible to every project gate
impact: .claude/settings.local.json grants Bash(node *), Bash(npm run *), Bash(git checkout *) and Bash(git add *). Bash(node *) is effectively arbitrary code execution. Bash(npm run *) supersedes the ask gates declared in .claude/settings.json for db:reset, performance:record, learning:record, evolution:record and task:record. Bash(git checkout *) permits path-restore, which reverts tracked append-only ledgers to HEAD, and every ledger is empty or stale at HEAD. The file is excluded by the user's global git ignore and is read by neither scripts/scan-agent-config-security.mjs nor scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs, so no security scan, validator or CI run can observe it. Separately, .claude/hooks/block-dangerous-command.mjs enumerates fifteen destructive patterns but omits git stash. During this session a specialist ran git stash to test whether a validation failure was pre-existing, and the coordinator-recorded DEC-0001 and DEC-0002 decision records were destroyed with no entry left in git stash list. Both decisions were re-recorded from their source payloads. permission-expansion is listed in ownerApprovalRequiredFor in .claude/evolution/policy.json, so this expansion was never approved.
evidence: .claude/settings.local.json allow list contains Bash(node *), Bash(npm run *), Bash(git checkout *), Bash(git add *)
.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-command.mjs lines 5-21 enumerate destructive patterns; git stash is absent

qarga-system-researcher reproduced the ledger destruction in an isolated scratch repository: a tracked ledger dropped to 0 records after git stash while a skip-worktree ledger survived, and git stash list ended empty
Coordinator observed decisions.jsonl at 0 records after successful recording, and re-recorded both decisions
.claude/evolution/policy.json lists permission-expansion and hook-behavior-change under ownerApprovalRequiredFor
remediation: Tracked as Work OS QW-0005. Sequence matters: add git stash and git checkout path-restore to the safety hook first, then bring settings.local.json under the security scanner and reduce its allow list, then fix the English-only walk, and only afterwards remove skip-worktree so ledgers become CI-visible. Removing skip-worktree before the hook guard would widen the blast radius, because skip-worktree is currently the only barrier protecting most ledgers.

reviewTrigger.value: Blocks any clean READY status for agent-system work; requires project-owner approval and security-auditor review before remediation

title: Login never establishes a real server session, so the newly wired registration call cannot succeed
impact: src/pages/Login.tsx calls only the local Zustand loginAsRole and registerStudent helpers and never calls api.requestOtp or api.verifyOtp, so the browser holds no real server session. RegistrationFlow.tsx was migrated to the server-authoritative api.createRegistration during QW-0004-S04, and the integration engineer verified against a live isolated server that an unauthenticated POST /api/registrations returns 401 unauthenticated. Consequence: the registration success path cannot complete end to end in the running application until Login is migrated, even though the client call, the price breakdown and the promo message are now correct. A second, smaller liability is the legacyOfferingId(courseId) bridge that derives an offering id as off-<courseId> because CourseDetail still reads mock-seeded courses from the store; this only holds for ids created by server/seed.mjs and will break for provider-created courses.
evidence: src/pages/Login.tsx uses store-local loginAsRole and registerStudent; api.requestOtp and api.verifyOtp are not called
qarga-integration-engineer verified against an isolated server copy on a scratch port: unauthenticated POST /api/registrations returns 401 unauthenticated with the message Giris teleb olunur
The same live run confirmed the authenticated happy path returns discount_minor 0, registration_fee_minor 2000, final_price_minor 11900 and promo_applied false, matching DEC-0001 and DEC-0002
legacyOfferingId helper documented in code as a temporary bridge in src/pages/student/RegistrationFlow.tsx
remediation: Tracked as Work OS QW-0004-S05 (migrate Login to the real OTP session API, reviewer security-auditor, owner approval required because it is an authentication change) and QW-0004-S06 (replace the legacy course-id bridge in CourseDetail, dependent on S05).

reviewTrigger.value: Must be resolved before DEC-0001 and DEC-0002 can be considered delivered to users and before any release-readiness READY status

title: Every registration read path is dead: six screens read a store array that nothing writes
impact: QW-0004-S04 correctly moved registration CREATION to the server, but the store action that used to populate src/store/useAppStore.ts registrations was deleted and no read path was migrated. src/store/useAppStore.ts:141 initialises registrations as an empty array and the only remaining reference at line 229 is updateRegistrationStatus, which maps over it. api.myRegistrations exists at src/lib/api.ts:291 and is called by no component. Consequence: after a student completes a real server-backed registration, it is visible only on the one-time confirmation screen. Student registration history, provider registrations, provider analytics, provider dashboard, admin registrations and the admin revenue figure all show empty or zero permanently. Admin revenue computes a reduce over an empty array, so it reports zero revenue regardless of real activity. A second, smaller issue: RegistrationHistory renders r.finalPrice against the legacy client-side Registration type in src/types/index.ts, which is structurally incompatible with the server Registration shape in src/lib/api.ts, so populating the array alone would not fix rendering. Lint, build and backend tests cannot detect any of this because it is a data-flow gap, not a type error.
evidence: src/store/useAppStore.ts:141 - registrations initialised as an empty array; line 229 only maps over it
src/pages/student/RegistrationHistory.tsx:35, src/pages/provider/useProviderScope.ts:8, src/pages/admin/AdminRegistrations.tsx:9, src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.tsx:12 all read the store array
src/pages/provider/ProviderAnalytics.tsx and src/pages/provider/ProviderDashboard.tsx consume the same array through useProviderScope
src/lib/api.ts:291 defines myRegistrations; grep of src/** shows no component calls it
Independently found by qarga-qa-auditor during QW-0004-S04 review and confirmed directly by the coordinator
remediation: Migrate the read paths to api.myRegistrations and the provider and admin equivalents, map the server RegistrationListItem shape, retire the legacy Registration type in src/types/index.ts for these screens, and give each screen real loading, empty and error states. Tracked as Work OS QW-0004-S07.

reviewTrigger.value: Blocks QW-0004-S04 acceptance and blocks any claim that DEC-0001 and DEC-0002 are delivered to users; a provider or admin cannot see a real registration end to end

title: Work OS, task contract and performance history are hidden from git by skip-worktree and exist only on one machine
impact: git ls-files -v reports the skip-worktree bit (S) on .claude/performance/ledger.jsonl, .claude/tasks/contracts.jsonl, .claude/work-os/events.jsonl and .claude/work-os/state.json. Git therefore reports no change to these four files no matter how much they grow, so they never appear in git status, are never captured by git add -A, and are invisible to every review and gate. Their committed HEAD versions are near-empty stubs of 208, 0, 0 and 137 bytes, while the local working copies are 11677, 34442, 25779 and 66792 bytes and hold 68 Work OS events, 51 task contracts and 8 performance evaluations. CLAUDE.md designates Work OS the operational source of truth for delegated work across sessions, yet none of that truth is version controlled, backed up, or visible in any other clone. Loss of this working directory destroys the entire task, contract, review, score and owner-decision-gate history with no recovery path. The flag also caused a direct misdiagnosis: qarga-system-researcher used git status --porcelain on these files, received empty output, and concluded they were byte-identical to HEAD. The coordinator relayed that to the project owner as a broken CI pipeline. A clean clone of main runs the validator with exit 0, so CI was in fact green the whole time and the retraction had to be issued to the owner.
evidence: git ls-files -v .claude/performance/ledger.jsonl .claude/tasks/contracts.jsonl .claude/work-os/events.jsonl .claude/work-os/state.json returns S for all four
git show HEAD:<path> byte counts are 208, 0, 0 and 137 against local sizes 11677, 34442, 25779 and 66792
wc -l reports 68 lines in .claude/work-os/events.jsonl, 51 in .claude/tasks/contracts.jsonl and 8 in .claude/performance/ledger.jsonl

git clone --branch main into a scratch directory then node scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs exits 0 with 'Claude configuration valid: 20 agents, 42 skills, 34 commands, 5 future roles, 25 system scenarios, 0 warning(s)'
QW-0006 was created by the coordinator and appears 12 times in the local .claude/work-os/state.json while git diff --stat for that file is empty
remediation: Sequenced and approved by the project owner. First complete Work OS QW-0006-S01 so the validator stops rejecting quoted Azerbaijani evidence inside machine-written registries, since committing the real registries without that fix would break CI for real. Then clear the flag with git update-index --no-skip-worktree on all four paths, review the 127 records for anything sensitive, and commit the history so Work OS becomes durable across machines. Separately, add a deterministic check that fails when skip-worktree or assume-unchanged is set on any tracked file under .claude, so index-level hiding can never again defeat every gate silently.

reviewTrigger.value: Blocks any claim that Work OS is a durable cross-session source of truth, and blocks trusting git status as evidence for these paths; re-check immediately after QW-0006-S01 is accepted
